movies.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
movies.tagline: Welcome to the Second Quarter Quell.
movies.synopsis: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before Katniss Everdeen volunteers in her sister's place, commencing on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自苏珊·柯林斯的同名小说。故事发生在《饥饿游戏》事件发生前24年，讲述第50届饥饿游戏（第二次四分区叛乱纪念赛）抽签日当天，年轻的黑密斯·阿伯纳西被选中参赛的故事。

movies.title: Focker-in-Law
movies.synopsis: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, aims to marry Olivia, a strong-willed former hostage negotiator who appears to be his complete mismatch. To Greg's shock, father-in-law Jack Byrnes takes a liking to Olivia, and her unprecedented rise into his Circle of Trust sparks chaos in the family before Jack's 80th birthday party.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 格雷格·福克和帕姆·伯恩斯的儿子亨利已经长大成人，并决定与一位看似与他完全不合拍的女性奥利维亚·琼斯结婚。奥利维亚曾是一名FBI人质谈判专家。她自信地表示，这份职业经历让她完全有能力将亨利从被“情感绑架”的状态中“解救”出来。奥利维亚这种直率强势的性格让格雷格感到不安和不满。然而，前CIA特工杰克·伯恩斯——那位以严苛考验女婿闻名的岳父却因此对奥利维亚刮目相看，甚至欣赏她，并想邀请她加入家族的“信任圈”。

movies.title: You Can See Everything
movies.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 在被判入狱前的34天，臭名昭著的硅谷创始人伊丽莎白·霍姆斯邀请了一支持怀疑态度的摄制组记录她的一举一动。起初这是一部关于神秘罪犯的私密肖像，却演变成一场持续3年、坠入深渊的迷幻之旅。

movies.title: The Fox
movies.synopsis: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

movies.title: Hexed
movies.synopsis: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一名冲动、不拘一格的少女比莉意外发现自己拥有隐藏的魔法能力，由此进入广阔的女巫王国赫克塞。她与谨慎的母亲艾丽丝联手，揭开可能改变女巫世界的家族秘密。

movies.title: Wicker
movies.countryOrigin: United Kingdom / United States of America
movies.synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 海边小镇里有一个身上散发臭味的打渔女，饱受狭隘的邻居嘲讽，而她为自己找了个柳条做成的丈夫。这段离经叛道的爱情在保守的小镇里引起了怒火、嫉妒和轩然大波。

movies.title: Wild Horse Nine
movies.tagline: Sometimes you've got to do a terrible thing for the greater good.
movies.synopsis: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1973年智利，性格迥异的CIA特工克里斯和李被局长从圣地亚哥派往复活节岛，这对搭档将执行一项考验彼此信任和忠诚的任务。

movies.title: Primetime
movies.tagline: Are you ready to make television history?
movies.synopsis: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 聚焦电视主持人克里斯·汉森与他推出的一档真人秀节目“猎捕恋童癖”，该节目利用人员在网络上伪装成未成年人，引诱恋童癖进入摄影棚，并将其逮捕。

movies.title: Bad Apples
movies.synopsis: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 小学老师玛利亚尽力管教一班10岁孩子，却被一名不守规矩的学生拖累。随着自身事业承压、该生行为愈发恶劣，她做出错误决定，意外将这名学生带回并锁在家中。玛利亚本想反悔，可班级情况逐渐好转，同事和家长都为此欣喜，她就此陷入两难困境。

movies.title: Buddy
movies.synopsis: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一群孩子被困在看似欢乐的儿童电视节目中。随着橙色独角兽布迪露出凶残本性，这个充满歌舞与欢笑的世界逐渐显露出恐怖真相。

movies.title: Clayface
movies.synopsis: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 好莱坞新星马特·哈根遭犯罪头目毁容后，为恢复容貌接受先进治疗，却意外陷入疯狂，走上复仇之路。

movies.title: Wildwood
movies.tagline: How far would you go for those you love?
movies.synopsis: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 普鲁和同班同学柯蒂斯误入一片禁忌魔法森林，林中遍布魔法生灵、忠心伙伴与强大劲敌。二人踏上一场凶险万分的营救之旅，要从神秘女子亚历山德拉统领的鸦群手中，救出被掳走的婴儿弟弟麦克。

movies.title: Bitter Christmas
movies.synopsis: During a long December holiday weekend, a woman, whose mother has recently died, throws herself into work as a form of escape. Her relentless pace is interrupted when a panic attack forces her to take a break.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 广告总监埃尔莎在母亲于12月去世后，用工作麻痹自己以应对伤痛。一次惊恐发作迫使她停下脚步，她决定与好友帕特里夏前往兰萨罗特岛旅行。两位女性的故事与一位编剧兼电影导演的经历平行展开，探讨了生活与虚构如何密不可分地交织，有时甚至令人痛苦地纠缠。

movies.title: Fatherland
movies.synopsis: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编灵感涉及托马斯·曼的真实经历及其传记素材。1949年，诺贝尔文学奖得主托马斯·曼结束16年的美国流亡，首次重返战后的德国。他与女儿埃丽卡·曼驱车穿越满目疮痍的德国，从美军控制的法兰克福前往苏联控制的魏玛。旅途中，父女二人也重新面对彼此复杂的情感与家庭裂痕。

movies.title: The Incomer
movies.tagline: Welcome to Auk Isle. Population: one too many.
movies.synopsis: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded "Incomers". Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 苏格兰一座偏远岛屿上，伊斯拉与桑迪姐弟靠捕猎海鸟、讲述祖先故事为生，并竭力抵御外来者。一名笨拙的政府工作人员丹尼尔奉命将他们迁往大陆，打破了姐弟俩与世隔绝的生活。

movies.title: Ebenezer
movies.tagline: Before he was Scrooge, he was…
movies.synopsis: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自查尔斯·狄更斯小说《圣诞颂歌》。一位年迈的吝啬商人遭遇故友亡灵及圣诞过去、现在与未来的幽灵造访，被迫直面自己的过往，并踏上一段寻求幸福与救赎的超自然旅程。

movies.title: Chopin
movies.synopsis: He is the talk of the town, the most romantic figure of decadent Parisian nights. When his lungs start bleeding, Chopin knows his days are numbered. Composing becomes his only obsession. The ticking clock rushes him to revolutionize music.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1835年的巴黎，著名作曲家弗雷德里克·肖邦周旋于上流社会，一边举办音乐会、教琴以维持生计，一边与疾病作斗争。他创作杰作，参加派对，在贵族和皇室圈子里寻觅爱情。

movies.title: La Bola Negra
movies.synopsis: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 三个同性恋男子在西班牙历史上1932 年、1937 年和 2017 年三个不同时期的故事。

movies.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
movies.tagline: There is no third time. Everything ends here.
movies.synopsis: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 人类的罪与罚。已经，没法归零。战争将日本粉碎至“零”，哥斯拉的袭击更将它推至“负”的绝境。时间来到两年后，人民历尽痛苦磨难仍坚持复苏的步伐，看似终于可以回归正常生活……然而此时，巨兽再次袭来。它彻底摧毁这份希望，将人类推向新的绝望深渊！

movies.title: Blue Heron
movies.tagline: A testament to the things we carry with us.
movies.synopsis: A family of six's fresh start on 1990s Vancouver Island unravels as their youngest child, Sasha, witnesses the increasingly dangerous behavior of her older brother, Jeremy.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 20世纪90年代末，8岁的萨莎随匈牙利移民家庭搬到温哥华岛开始新生活。然而，哥哥杰里米日益危险的行为打破了家庭的平静，父母也被迫面对艰难的选择。

movies.title: How to Rob a Bank
movies.synopsis: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 别人抢劫东躲西藏，他们直播全网教学，别人抢劫只想暴富，他们只为分给需要的人！当规则不再公平，欲望横流的金钱游戏，谁才是真的掠夺者？.

movies.title: GIANT – The Play
movies.tagline: A world-famous children's author under threat. A battle of wills in the wake of scandal. And one chance to make amends.
movies.synopsis: Set in the summer of 1983, just before the release of The Witches, Giant imagines a tense meeting between Roald Dahl and his American and British publishers as they scramble to contain the fallout from his public denunciation of Israel and defence of the Palestinians in a review of a book on the 1982 Lebanon war. Filmed live onstage at the Harold Pinter Theatre in London's West End in 2025.

movies.title: Pressure
movies.tagline: In the hours before D-Day, one decision changed the world.
movies.synopsis: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1944年，诺曼底登陆进入最后72小时，盟军大规模登陆部队已经集结完毕，一切准备就绪，唯独难以预测的天气成为决定行动成败的关键。气象学家詹姆斯·斯塔格上校根据自己的判断预警风暴即将来临，但推迟行动同样可能导致盟军部署暴露。面对来自盟军高层的巨大压力，斯塔格必须坚持自己的气象判断，而最终决定权则掌握在盟军最高司令德怀特·艾森豪威尔手中。数十万将士的安危与诺曼底登陆的成败，都悬于这场与时间和天气的艰难博弈之中……

movies.title: Ramayana: Part 1
movies.synopsis: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自印度古代史诗《罗摩衍那》。魔王罗波那作恶多端，欲用武力一统三界。毗湿奴神化身罗摩降临凡尘，担起守护众生的重任。十四年流放间罗摩降妖除魔，一步步激怒了罗波那。当妻子悉多被掳走，彻底点燃了罗摩心中的战意。

movies.title: I Love Boosters
movies.tagline: Booster: Somebody who steals clothes from a store and sells them at a discount price, aka community service.
movies.synopsis: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing from her stores and reselling them at a lower price — what they call 'fashion-forward philanthropy'.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 在旧金山湾区一个超现实的平行世界里，一群被称为"顺风手"的商店扒手，将矛头对准了一位剽窃他们设计的心狠手辣的冷酷时尚大亨。

movies.title: Sense and Sensibility
movies.tagline: No one knows your heart like a sister.
movies.synopsis: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自简·奥斯汀的同名经典名著。乔治亚时期英格兰，达什伍德先生去世后，遗孀与三名女儿失去庄园继承权，被迫迁居乡间简陋房屋。长女埃莉诺与次女玛丽安在拮据处境与社会压力下各自面对求婚、心碎与对真爱的探寻。

movies.title: The Odyssey
movies.countryOrigin: United Kingdom / United States of America
movies.synopsis: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 克里斯托弗·诺兰将荷马笔下的怪物搬上银幕，打造了一部在全球多地取景拍摄的神话动作史诗。这是一场无与伦比的电影盛事。[环球影业]

movies.title: Erupcja
movies.synopsis: A romantic vacation goes awry when a volcanic eruption strands Bethany and her boyfriend, Rob, in Warsaw, Poland. Taking the explosive event as a sign to ditch her baggage, Bethany reunites with her childhood friend, Nel, to traipse through lofts, clubs, and back alleys—all while becoming entangled in an emotional web that challenges her sense of self.

movies.title: JIFF: The Heroes of the Louvre

movies.title: JIFF: Just an Illusion
movies.synopsis: In 1985 suburban Paris, 12-year-old Vincent lives with his distant older brother and quarrelling parents. Amid laughter and unease, he navigates friendship and first love, while beginning to confront the adult world.

movies.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
movies.synopsis: A stunning delve into George Michael's 1988 Faith Tour, as shot live at the famous Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy. This exclusive footage, assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm over two nights (30–31 May 1988), features the 24-year-old pop star at the height of his powers.

movies.title: Steal This Story, Please!
movies.synopsis: New York-based independent investigative journalist Amy Goodman has been reporting from hotspots around the world for decades: from East Timor to Morocco, Nigeria, and Gaza, and closer to home during 9/11 and the Iraq War. Goodman and a small group of colleagues present the daily online, TV, and radio news program Democracy Now!, which has been on the air since 1996 with no government funding, thanks to contributions from donors, foundations, and news consumers.

movies.title: The Devils
movies.tagline: Hell will hold no surprises for them...
movies.synopsis: In 1634 France, charismatic Father Urbain Grandier becomes the target of sexually depraved Sister Jeanne's accusations of witchcraft, which corrupt officials of church and state are all too happy to exploit.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自阿尔多斯·赫胥黎的历史纪实作品《卢丹的恶魔》及约翰·怀廷的同名戏剧。17世纪的法国，于尔班·格兰第神父被指控对一群修女施行巫术。随着修道院爆发集体附魔事件，宗教狂热与政治权力相互勾结，将他卷入一场迫害风暴。

movies.title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth

douban.chineseTitle: 克里夫·布斯的惊险再冒险

movies.synopsis: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 在《好莱坞往事》事件发生八年后，克里夫·布斯回到日新月异的洛杉矶。他在好莱坞制片厂体系的阴影下以一名片场问题处理人的身份谋生，却发现自己卷入了一张由秘密、罪行与背叛交织而成的危险罗网——这一切将彻底考验他对忠诚与生存的全部认知。

movies.title: Tenzing
movies.synopsis: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 根据真实事件改编。喜马拉雅登山家丹增·诺盖与新西兰登山家埃德蒙·希拉里携手登顶珠穆朗玛峰，成为首批登顶者。在妻子达瓦和探险队秘书吉尔·亨德森的支持下，丹增争取加入英国登山队，在攀登过程中面对文化差异、阶级矛盾与高山险境。

movies.title: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express

douban.chineseTitle: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express: Live On-Stage

movies.synopsis: Andrew Lloyd Webber's Starlight Express races back onto the stage in a spectacular new production, where trains come to life, dreams are on the line, and only one can become champion.

movies.title: Pan's Labyrinth (2006)
movies.tagline: Innocence has a power evil cannot imagine.
movies.synopsis: In post–civil war Spain, 10-year-old Ofelia moves with her pregnant mother to live under the control of her cruel stepfather. Drawn into a mysterious labyrinth, she meets a faun who reveals that she may be a lost princess from an underground kingdom. To return to her true father, she must complete a series of surreal and perilous tasks that blur the line between reality and fantasy.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 这部荣获奥斯卡奖的黑暗童话，以西班牙内战结束五年后为背景，浓缩了吉列尔莫·德尔托罗视觉风格浓烈、突破类型桎梏的独特匠心。十一岁的奥菲莉亚（伊万娜·巴克罗饰，表演兼具成熟韵味与纯真质感）随怀孕的母亲迁往乡间，被迫直面法西斯统治的恐怖——她的新任继父正是弗朗哥将军麾下嗜血成性的军官，奉命剿灭拒不投降的共和军游击队。当奥菲莉亚在颓败迷宫中遇见农牧神，现实暴力与奇幻秘境便无缝交融：她由此踏上一段诡谲壮丽的神话旅程，集惊悚与华美于一体。导演通过重探西班牙史上的血腥时期，生动展现战争暴行如何渗入孩童的想象疆域，浸染纯真年华。[标准收藏]

movies.title: Parky
movies.synopsis: How did a miner’s son from working-class Yorkshire, who rose to become television’s greatest interviewer and die a knighted Sir, never truly believe in himself? A revelatory portrait of Michael Parkinson – the man behind the ‘Parky’ icon as told in his own words and from those closest to him.

movies.title: JIFF: Wish You Long Life
movies.synopsis: Wish You Long Life follows Adi and Maya, two childhood friends who have become estranged in recent years. When the sudden death of their best friend Reuben brings them back together, they reconnect and retrace the lives they once imagined for themselves and reckon with their past experiences with bullying, exclusion and antisemitism. Through this journey, they grapple with whether they should hide their cultural identity, or be proud of it.

movies.title: Virginia Woolf's Night and Day

douban.chineseTitle: 弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫的夜与日

movies.synopsis: In 1910 London, an independent-minded young woman challenges her family’s expectations of marriage to pursue astronomy, questioning the restrictions of society, love, and tradition as she searches for a life of her own.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 讲述了两位女性在爱德华时代的伦敦，通过爱情的磨砺，最终打破传统束缚、寻找真实自我的故事。这不仅是一个关于“选对伴侣”的爱情故事，更是关于女性如何在“传统（夜）”与“现实（日）”中觉醒，勇敢掌控自己命运的独立宣言。

movies.title: Zombucha!
movies.synopsis: After one particularly catastrophic day at their respective workplaces, busy professionals Maddie and Leo find themselves both unemployed. Dreaming of a fresh start but needing reliable income to support the family they hope to start together, the couple have a chance encounter with Kai, a smouldering kombucha artisan raking in the cash. Seeing dollar signs, Maddie and Leo swipe Kai's kombucha culture to kickstart their own enterprise, but when they mix in some mysterious herbs from a neighbour's garden, the culture gains sentience and proves deadly. With their relationship hanging by a thread, can Maddie and Leo unite to prevent a full-blown zombucha apocalypse?

movies.title: Savage House
movies.tagline: Polite society has never been so Savage.
movies.synopsis: Against the backdrop of 18th century England, a massive pox outbreak, and Jacobite uprising – Sir Chauncey Savage and Lady Savage blindly pursue a better life. It's not without a tinge of irony that their family name is the Savages, for this is a Savage House indeed, filled with duels, decadence, and bloodshed.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 故事设定在18世纪的英国，正值天花大流行与詹姆斯党起义的动荡时期。萨维奇爵士与野心勃勃的妻子萨维奇夫人，不顾一切地追逐地位与财富。他们对时代灾难视而不见，疯狂的执念让家族庄园沦为荒诞、奢靡与血腥的舞台：决斗频发、联盟在晚宴上轻易崩塌，家族姓氏“Savage”（野蛮）成了绝妙讽刺。这是一部黑色讽刺喜剧，辛辣解构阶级、权力与人性的贪婪 。

movies.title: Queen at Sea
movies.synopsis: As advanced dementia erodes an older woman's ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interests, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection and autonomy.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 阿尔茨海默病逐渐剥夺了一位女性表达自我的能力，也严重影响了她与他人的沟通。她的丈夫与女儿竭力为她谋求最大福祉——在爱与关怀、守护与自主之间的脆弱边界中艰难探寻平衡。

movies.title: 500 Miles
movies.synopsis: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 16岁的芬恩和弟弟查理为避免父母分居后被拆散，连夜离家，从英国前往爱尔兰西海岸寻找与家人疏远的祖父，踏上一场跨越500英里的旅程。

movies.title: O.M: Operation Mole
movies.synopsis: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.

movies.title: The Little Rascals (1994)
movies.synopsis: When nine-year-old Alfalfa falls for Darla, his "He-Man-Woman-Hating" friends attempt to sabotage their relationship.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 乐翻天的美国爆笑儿童喜剧，里面的小演员和那只狗狗的都激萌激萌的不要不要的。讲述的是几个男孩都想追求女孩达娜，在他们之间发生的各种纠结趣事，就是儿童世界的为了爱情，与兄弟们反目。央视曾引进过。

movies.title: Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf? (1966)
movies.tagline: You are cordially invited to George and Martha's for an evening of fun and games
movies.synopsis: A history professor and his wife entertain a young couple who are new to the university's faculty. As the drinks flow, secrets come to light, and the middle-aged couple unload onto their guests the full force of the bitterness, dysfunction, and animosity that defines their marriage.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 剧情描写教授和他的妻子发生了矛盾冲突，妻子设下圈套，请一对很有才华的年轻夫妇吃饭，并伺机与那位年轻的丈夫调情。调情未遂就歇斯底里大发作，几乎毁了那年轻的一对。影片揭示了美国社会、家庭、婚姻关系上存在的问题，通过对上流社会知识分子阶层的虚伪和丑行，探讨了道德的标准和界限问题。

movies.title: Hamilton (2020)
movies.tagline: The story of America then, told by America now.
movies.synopsis: Presenting the tale of American founding father Alexander Hamilton, this filmed version of the original Broadway smash hit is the story of America then, told by America now.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 本片是以当代视角演绎的美国往事。这部作品融合嘻哈、爵士、R&B与音乐剧曲风，通过美国开国元勋亚历山大·汉密尔顿的故事，缔造了戏剧界的革命性时刻——一部对文化、政治与教育产生深远影响的音乐剧。本片于2016年6月在百老汇理查德·罗杰斯剧院现场录制，以独特而沉浸的方式将观众带入这场百老汇演出的世界。[迪士尼]

movies.title: Cinderella (1950)
movies.synopsis: When her father unexpectedly passes away, young Ella finds herself at the mercy of her cruel stepmother and her daughters. Never one to give up hope, Ella's fortunes begin to change after meeting a dashing stranger in the woods.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 母亲去世后，瑞拉（莉莉·詹姆斯 Lily James 饰）的父亲迎娶了美丽的特曼妮夫人（凯特·布兰切特 Cate Blanchett 饰），特曼妮夫人还带来了她的两个女儿安泰西亚（荷丽黛·格兰杰 Holliday Grainger 饰）和崔西里亚（索菲·麦希拉 Sophie McShera 饰）。瑞拉本着善待他人的善良之心和继母与两个姐姐和平共处，然而，这一切却在父亲去世后发生了翻天覆地的变化。  　　失去了父亲的庇护，瑞拉彻底沦为了特曼妮夫人的奴隶和家中的女佣，可是，即使饱受亲人们的压迫与侮辱，瑞拉依然决定留下来，守护这个家庭。一次偶然中，瑞拉邂逅了名为基特（理查德·麦登 Richard Madden 饰）的男子，然而，她并不知道眼前这个充满了魅力的年轻人贵为王子，还以为他只是区区侍从。王子在王宫里举办了大型的宴会，邀请全国上下的少女们前往参加，瑞拉也想去，但特曼妮夫人显然并不喜欢她的这个主意。

movies.title: Mildred Pierce (1945)
movies.tagline: Please don't tell anyone what Mildred Pierce did!
movies.synopsis: A hard-working mother inches towards disaster as she divorces her husband and starts a successful restaurant business to support her spoiled daughter.
movies.chineseTagline: 请不要告诉任何人米尔德丽德·皮尔斯做了什么！
movies.chineseSynopsis: 好莱坞大师迈克尔·柯蒂兹在这幅浸染着黑色影调的母性牺牲肖像中，谱写了一曲家庭伦理悲剧。琼·克劳馥饰演的米尔德里德，是一位执意让子女摆脱经济困窘之辱的单亲母亲，这一标志性演出不仅巩固了克劳馥的事业回归，更为她斩获演艺生涯中唯一一座奥斯卡奖杯。然而，当米尔德里德凭借顽强毅力从沉着镇定的女侍者一路拼搏成为连锁餐厅的阔绰业主时，她那物质至上的长女（安·布莱丝 饰，其演绎堪称邪典）却以毒蛇噬心般的忘恩负义，不断触发绝望的妥协与无情的责难，使母女陷入无尽循环的深渊。影片将詹姆斯·M·凯恩笔下层次丰富的心理小说重构为一桩凶案谜题，这杯混杂着盲目母爱与美式野心的苦涩鸡尾酒，既拥有冷酷无情的故事质地，亦饱含汹涌澎湃的情感张力。

movies.title: JIFF: Tell Me Everything
movies.synopsis: Amid the late ’80s pop craze and rising HIV epidemic, 12-year-old Boaz uncovers a devastating secret about the father he idolizes that threatens to tear his family apart. Across a yearslong journey, Boaz seeks to heal the wound and reclaim the father-son bond he never stopped yearning for.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1987年，12岁的博阿兹发现了备受他崇敬的父亲梅厄的惊人秘密，彻底颠覆了他的世界，并给家庭带来毁灭性后果。十年后，深陷愧疚的博阿兹踏上旅程，试图直面过去的心魔。

movies.title: JIFF: Cancelled
movies.synopsis: A performance-based short film, exploring guilt, shame and sexuality. 3 stories emerge surrounding gender identity, promiscuity and motherhood.

movies.title: JIFF: Women on Trial
movies.synopsis: 1972. A landmark trial shakes France as young Marie-Claire is prosecuted for having an illegal abortion with the help of her mother and two other defendants. In a courtroom governed by men, the verdict seems inevitable: prison for the women, while the rapist goes unpunished. Their last hope lies with Gisèle Halimi, a fearless lawyer known for openly challenging patriarchy and confronting the system that condemns victims and lets perpetrators walk free. Alongside the accused, Gisèle will not only change their fate, but, against all odds, transform the condition of women forever
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1972年11月，在沸腾的博比尼法庭上，一场历史性审判震撼了法国社会。法庭审理的是玛丽-克莱尔·舍瓦利耶一案，这位16岁的少女在母亲的协助下非法堕胎。她们的律师吉泽尔·哈利米不为两名堕胎“罪犯”辩护，而是将这场诉讼作为对一条极不公正的法律的控诉。

movies.title: JIFF: The Sea
movies.synopsis: After his older brother passes away, Lee Chandler is forced to return home to care for his 16-year-old nephew. There he is compelled to deal with a tragic past that separated him from his family and the community where he was born and raised.
movies.chineseTagline: 每个人都有权力不与自己的过去和解
movies.chineseSynopsis: 在兄长猝然离世后，李·钱德勒震惊地得知自己被指定为侄子帕特里克的唯一监护人。李不得不暂停工作，勉强回到故乡曼彻斯特照顾这个十五岁的活泼少年，同时也被迫直面那段令他与妻子兰迪分离、与成长之地决裂的往事。曾被兄长凝聚的家庭纽带如今断裂，李与帕特里克在失去至亲的阴影下，艰难地摸索着与世界和解的方式。

movies.title: Frank and Percy
movies.tagline: It's never too late to fall in love.
movies.synopsis: During their dog walks on Hampstead Heath, two older gentlemen find their conversations about everyday aches and weather growing into an unexpected connection.

movies.title: JIFF: Paper Tiger
movies.tagline: All debts are paid in blood.
movies.synopsis: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 聚焦一对在追求“美国梦”过程中深陷泥潭的兄弟。原本看似美好的致富契机，却是一场精心策划的骗局。随着局势失控，两人不仅要应对充斥着腐败与暴力的危险世界，更要面对来自俄罗斯黑帮的残酷威胁。在极端考验下，曾经牢不可破的兄弟情谊开始崩塌，背叛也变得近在咫尺。

movies.title: JIFF: Visitation
movies.synopsis: A plot of land, a house by the lake, its changing inhabitants. This one plot of land reflects 70 years of German history from Weimar, the Nazis, the war, the Soviet occupation and reconstruction to the fall of the GDR.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自珍妮·埃彭贝克的同名小说。柏林近郊湖畔的一栋房子，见证了一个世纪的战争、政权更迭、德国统一与时代变迁。几代人、十二种命运在此聚散离合，寻找安宁与归属，而房子始终静静守望着时代洪流中的众生。

movies.title: JIFF: The Mad Dog of Europe
movies.synopsis: A documentary exploring the 1933 screenplay of the same name by Citizen Kane co-writer Herman Mankiewicz, which warned of Adolf Hitler's rise to power, but was rejected by Hollywood studios at the time.

movies.title: The Three Urns
movies.synopsis: Back in his home country to spread the ashes of his beloved wife, a man races to his destination. In a milk float. Chased by a beautiful French woman in a smart car, plagued with battery issues.

movies.title: Hill
movies.synopsis: In 1996, Damon Hill claimed the Formula 1 world championship—defying the odds and overcoming familial tragedy to step out of his father’s shadow and become a racing legend in his own right.

movies.title: The Lost Children of Tuam
movies.synopsis: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

movies.title: Verity
movies.tagline: There is no light where we're going.
movies.synopsis: Lowen Ashleigh, hired to ghostwrite for best-selling author Verity Crawford, uncovers Verity's autobiographical notes, and becomes involved in what may prove to be a lethal conspiracy.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自科琳·胡佛的同名小说。知名作家维莉蒂·克劳福德因意外受伤后，洛温·阿什利受聘代笔完成她的系列小说，并搬进克劳福德家中。洛温意外发现维莉蒂令人不安的自传手稿，逐渐陷入真假难辨的秘密、操纵与执念之中。

movies.title: NAZA
movies.tagline: A window into systems of mass killing.
movies.synopsis: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 影片在夜晚的特拉维夫屋顶拍摄，揭示以色列在加沙对巴勒斯坦平民实施大规模杀戮背后的系统。

movies.title: JIFF: To Kill A Nazi
movies.tagline: A second chance comes only once
movies.synopsis: A documentary feature by award-winning filmmaker Boaz Dvir, “To Kill a Nazi” tells the story of a French family man who sets out in to kill his father’s Gestapo executioner and ended up playing a pivotal role in history’s most audacious hostage rescue.

movies.title: JIFF: Where To?
movies.countryOrigin: United Kingdom / United States of America
movies.tagline: Explore a new era of J.K. Rowling's Wizarding World.
movies.synopsis: In 1926, Newt Scamander arrives at the Magical Congress of the United States of America with a magically expanded briefcase, which houses a number of dangerous creatures and their habitats. When the creatures escape from the briefcase, it sends the American wizarding authorities after Newt, and threatens to strain even further the state of magical and non-magical relations.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 故事发生在1926年的纽约，彼时，麻鸡们对魔法师的抵制达到了最高峰，由玛丽露所领导的反魔法组织活动频繁。与此同时，街头巷尾之中时时发生的种种灾难意外让魔法世界的存在离暴露仅有一线之隔，整个魔法部陷入了空前紧张的气氛之中。  就在这个节骨眼上，环游世界进行着研究神奇魔法动物之行动的魔法动物学家纽特·斯卡曼德抵达了纽约，他随身携带的魔法手提箱里，装着几十种他一路营救的魔法动物们，而他的一举一动，均处于隶属于魔法部的前傲罗蒂娜的监视之下。一场意外中，麻鸡雅各布误拿了纽特的手提箱，并且放出了藏在箱子里的魔法动物，为此，纽特、蒂娜、雅各布和蒂娜的妹妹奎妮不得不踏上了寻找魔法动物的旅途。

movies.title: California Schemin'
movies.synopsis: After being ridiculed for their Scottish accents, two ambitious musicians reinvent themselves as American rappers and fool the British music industry into a lucrative record deal, only for their elaborate lie to unravel under the weight of instant fame.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 影片聚焦一起真实的骗局：00年代初，两个苏格兰邓迪走出的男子想闯说唱界，但因为口音而被拒绝、破产，于是他俩操起美国口音，假扮成一个在加州享有盛名的rapper组合——Silibil N' Brains，以此实现他们的唱片合约梦。随着名利的诱惑和谎言的堆积，他们的友谊受到了考验。

movies.title: Four Weddings and a Funeral (1994)
movies.tagline: Five good reasons to stay single.
movies.synopsis: Over the course of five social occasions, a committed bachelor must consider the notion that he may have discovered love.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 查尔斯是婚礼上的常客，却对结婚却怀有疑惧。一次乡间婚礼上，他对美丽的美国姑娘凯莉一见钟情。虽然从朋友口中查尔斯听到凯莉的很多坏话，但他还是推掉了朋友们的邀请前去寻找凯莉。两人度过一个美好的夜晚。但第二天凯莉竟只身回了美国，弄得查尔斯心神不宁。查尔斯的朋友们一个个都开始准备结婚。两个月后，在伦敦的一个婚礼上，查尔斯凯莉重又相逢。就在查尔斯满心欢喜之时，凯莉却向他介绍了自己的未婚夫。查尔斯非常失落。女友海伦娜向他表达爱意，他根本无心回应。凯莉前来寻找查尔斯，两人再次共度良宵。 一个月后，查尔斯收到了凯莉的结婚请柬。在选礼物时，查尔斯遇上了凯莉。凯莉向查尔斯说起了自己的风流韵史。冲动的查尔斯想向凯莉求婚，但始终没能开口。查尔斯还是去参加了凯莉的婚礼，心灰意冷的他接受了海伦娜。查尔斯的朋友盖诺斯心脏病突发去世。葬礼上，查尔斯又见到了凯莉，终于向她表白。

movies.title: Heated Rivalry – A Special Marathon Event

douban.chineseTitle: Heated Rivalry – A Special Marathon Event

movies.title: My Fair Lady (1964)
movies.tagline: The loverliest motion picture of them all!
movies.synopsis: A snobbish phonetics professor agrees to a wager that he can take a flower girl and make her presentable in high society.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 卖花女伊莉莎·杜利特尔（奥黛丽·赫本 饰），长得眉清目秀，聪明乖巧，但出身寒微，家境贫寒。她每天到街头叫卖鲜花，赚点钱补贴家用。一天，伊莉莎低俗的嗓音引起了语言学家希金斯教授（雷克斯·哈里森 饰）的注意，教授夸口只要经过他的训练，卖花女也可以成为贵夫人。伊莉莎觉得教授说的话对她是一个机会，就主动上门请求教授训练她。教授的朋友皮克林（维尔弗雷德·海德-怀特 饰）和他打赌，如果让伊莉莎以贵夫人的身份出席6个月后将举办的大使游园会而不被人识破真相，那么皮克林愿意承担一切试验费用和伊莉莎的学费，这激起了教授的斗志，希金斯欣然接受了挑战。他是不甘示弱的，他从最基本的字母发音开始教起。希金斯是个精力旺盛和讲究科学的学者，对每一感兴趣件事都能废寝忘食。他胸怀坦荡、丝毫不怀任何恶意，但他又像孩子一样，毫不顾及他人的感情，对伊莉莎严加训练。

movies.title: Shakespeare in Love (1998)
movies.synopsis: Young William Shakespeare is forced to stage his latest comedy, 'Romeo and Ethel, the Pirate's Daughter', before it's even written. When lovely noblewoman Viola de Lesseps auditions for a role, they fall into forbidden love — and Shakespeare's play finds a new life (and title). As their relationship intensifies, the comedy soon transforms into tragedy.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 本片是一部背景设定在1590年代、献给1990年代的浪漫喜剧。它富有想象力地铺陈出这部旷世爱情杰作背后那段妙趣横生、香艳动人且永恒传世的创作故事。[米拉麦克斯影业]

movies.title: JIFF: Spaceballs (1987)
movies.tagline: May the schwartz be with you.
movies.synopsis: When the nefarious Dark Helmet hatches a plan to snatch Princess Vespa and steal her planet's air, space-bum-for-hire Lone Starr and his clueless sidekick fly to the rescue. Along the way, they meet Yogurt, who puts Lone Starr wise to the power of "The Schwartz." Can he master it in time to save the day?
movies.chineseSynopsis: 在很久以前的遥远星系中，“炮弹一族”因其领袖的愚蠢，耗尽了自己星球的大气，于是计划夺取邻近的朱迪亚星球的纯净空气。在朱迪亚星球维斯帕公主（达芙妮•祖尼加 Daphne Zuniga 饰）婚礼前夕，炮弹族总统斯古（梅尔•布鲁克斯 Mel Brooks 饰）派出黑帽子大人率领巨型战舰绑架维斯帕，以威胁朱迪亚方面就范。维斯帕拒绝没有爱情的婚姻选择逃婚，却陷入了炮弹族巨舰的追击，这时，因为欠高利贷在太空中奔逃的太空牛仔“孤星”（比尔•普尔曼 Bill Pullman 饰）与半人半狗的搭档巴夫受朱迪亚国王所托，出面将维斯帕救走。炮弹族岂肯善罢甘休，正邪势力在太空上演了又一场激战……

movies.title: JIFF: For The Love of a Woman
movies.synopsis: Portrait of a strong and independent woman who hides a painful past.

movies.title: Aakasamlo Oka Tara
movies.synopsis: A girl from a remote village dreams of becoming an astronaut and wishes to defy the odds and doubts from those around her.

movies.title: Videodrome (1983)
movies.tagline: First it controls your mind. Then it destroys your body.
movies.synopsis: As the president of a trashy TV channel, Max Renn is desperate for new programming to attract viewers. When he happens upon "Videodrome," a TV show dedicated to gratuitous torture and punishment, Max sees a potential hit and broadcasts the show on his channel. However, after his girlfriend auditions for the show and never returns, Max investigates the truth behind Videodrome and discovers that the graphic violence may not be as fake as he thought.
movies.chineseTagline: 首先它控制你的思想，然后它摧毁你的身体。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 马克思（James Woods 饰）是一家小型电视台的台长，为提高收视率，马克思四处搜罗带有色情或暴力内容的剧集。马克思的下属哈兰盗用卫星信号，获取了一档名为影视场的节目，内容为写实粗糙的暴力虐待场面，马克思看过这套节目后无法忘怀，对其他剧集丧失了兴趣。电台主播尼奇（Deborah Harry 饰）与马克思相识不久，这名有受虐倾向的女子也被影视场吸引，奔赴节目可能的产地匹兹堡欲参与制作。马克思经人指点拜访影视场的创始人布莱恩教授却没有见到真人，教授寄来的以尼奇为主角的录像让马克思产生了幻觉，马克思再度拜访始知布莱恩早已被杀死，现在的影视场节目由惊人视力公司的巴里负责，马克思一步步落入了巴里设计好的圈套，在巴里与布莱恩两种力量间越陷越深……

movies.title: Drive (2011)
movies.synopsis: A young mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star — officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything — including what's already become so much more than just a deal.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 一位年轻的赛车技师假装与赛车界最具争议的的明星车手订婚，表面上是为了维护他的名声，实则是为了自己能有机会成为赛车手。但很快，这个谎言就威胁到一切，包括这段早已超越单纯交易的感情…

movies.title: The Dead Zone (1983)
movies.tagline: In his mind, he has the power to see the future. In his hands, he has the power to change it.
movies.synopsis: Johnny Smith is a schoolteacher with his whole life ahead of him but, after leaving his fiancee's home one night, is involved in a car crash which leaves him in a coma for 5 years. When he wakes, he discovers he has an ability to see into the past, present and future life of anyone with whom he comes into physical contact.
movies.chineseTagline: 他心中自有洞悉未来的力量，他手中亦有扭转乾坤的权能。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 尊尼在回家不幸撞上十八轮的大货车，死里逃生，昏迷了五年，在桑恩维萨克大夫的治疗下，终于醒了。撞伤后的尊尼，变成有奇特的超能力，不但能预测护士家失火，也能看到大夫的过去，顿成镇上的风云人物。

movies.title: The Fence
movies.synopsis: Horn is welcoming his partner Léone into the hut he shares with Cal, when a man called Alboury appears. He stays there until they return the body of his brother, who was killed on the site.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 西非一项浩大的公共工程。霍恩是工地经理，卡尔是年轻工程师，两人同住在工地大院的双重大门后面。霍恩的新婚妻子莱奥内前来与他们同住，就在当晚，一个男人出现在围栏外。他叫阿尔布里。如同黑暗中的幽灵，他索要当天早些时候在工地死去的兄弟的遗体。他将整夜纠缠这两个男人，直到他们归还遗体，而莱奥内则眼睁睁看着这场灾难在眼前上演。

movies.title: Street Fighter
movies.synopsis: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!
movies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自卡普空同名系列格斗游戏。1993年，昔日形同兄弟的街头格斗家隆与肯因春丽的邀请重返赛场，参加世界格斗王大赛。然而，一场致命阴谋潜伏其中，迫使两人再次面对彼此与各自的过去。

movies.title: JIFF: Block 10
movies.synopsis: In early 1943, at the Auschwitz main camp, hundreds of Jewish women are confined in cramped quarters in BLOCK 10, which is separated from the rest of the camp grounds. Nazi doctors subject them to the most painful methods of forced sterilization. Prisoner doctors are forced to collaborate. The Jewish gynecologist Dr. Maximilian Samuel is blackmailed with the gassing of his 20-year-old daughter if he refuses to participate in the brutal experiments. Caught in this moral dilemma, he seeks his own path.

movies.title: JIFF: The Soundman
movies.tagline: The crossed destinies of a boy and a young woman on the eve of the German invasion of Belgium in 1940.
movies.synopsis: May 1940. As Europe trembles on the brink of war, two lives cross within Brussels’ legendary Flagey building, the beating heart of national radio. Elza, a young actress making her debut in radio drama, meets Berre, a gifted soundman with a magical ear. She is enchanted by storytelling; he finds solace in sound. Their encounter sparks a love that dares to exist beyond the rising shadow of their time.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 故事发生在1940年5月，彼时欧洲正处于战争爆发的边缘。影片讲述了两个人的命运在布鲁塞尔传奇般的弗拉吉（Flagey）大楼——这座国家广播电台的“心脏”——交织在一起的故事。初涉广播剧界的年轻女演员埃尔莎（Elza），邂逅了才华横溢、拥有一双近乎神奇听觉的音效师贝雷（Berre）。她沉醉于讲述故事的魔力之中，而他则在声音那神秘的力量里找到了心灵的栖息地。两人的相遇点燃了一段爱情，这段爱情无惧于当时日益逼近的战火阴影，勇敢地绽放。

movies.title: Ashes and Diamonds
movies.tagline: Touched with the fire and rebellion of a new generation of Polish film makers
movies.synopsis: A young academy soldier, Maciek Chelmicki, is ordered to shoot the secretary of the KW PPR. A coincidence causes him to kill someone else. Meeting face to face with his victim, he gets a shock. He faces the necessity of repeating the assassination.  He meets Krystyna, a girl working as a barmaid in the restaurant of the "Monopol" hotel. His affection for her makes him even more aware of the senselessness of killing at the end of the war. Loyalty to the oath he took, and thus the obligation to obey the order, tips the scales.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 1945年德国战败，驱逐外侮的波兰社会却并未迎来真正的和平。不同派系、官僚之间的仇杀不时出现……马契克（Zbigniew Cybulski 饰）与长官安杰依奉老上司、市长斯维茨基命令，暗杀新到任的工人党地区书记斯祝卡，但马契克一时大意误杀两名无辜工人。 　　斯维茨基即将升任部长大摆筵席，马契克沉浸在伤害无辜的深深内疚中，只能借与酒吧女克里斯蒂娜的短暂关系排解苦闷，安杰依要求马契克重新振作，执行军人的天职。斯祝卡厌恶当地官员们的浮华纵乐，然而他却连自己失散的儿子都无法找回。茫茫夜色中，马契克找到斯祝卡，两人同时要面对战后废墟中的宿命安排。 　　本片获1959年威尼斯电影节国际影评人费比西奖。是导演安杰依·瓦伊达（Andrzej Wajda）战争三部曲的收官之作。

movies.title: Yesterday Island
movies.synopsis: When failed novelist Amos agrees to mind his friend's research station on a remote island for just one day, he expects solitude and a chance to break his writer's block. But when his friend fails to return, Amos discovers he has been deliberately trapped in a bizarre time loop. In a desperate attempt to escape "yesterday", Amos coaxes his ex-wife onto the island, but instead strands them both there. To ensure their own freedom, the two must scheme to invite their most dislikeable friends to the island, with unforeseen and messy consequences. A quirky dark comedy about second chances, petty revenge, and the ultimate importance of forgiveness.

movies.title: Chasing Millions
movies.tagline: And still chasing... A true(ish) story of a legendary bank job.
movies.synopsis: The Northern Bank chain was owned by the National Australia Bank. Diana, a young Australian police detective in Belfast at the same time, seizes the opportunity to investigate the biggest crime of her career and prove herself to her misogynistic bosses back home who have passed her over for promotion. Diana is teamed with Crawford, a gruff, veteran Northern Irish police detective who does not want her help. As the case takes one more bizarre turn after another, the duo learn to grudgingly respect each other. As they almost give up hope of catching the criminals, Diana comes up with an ingenious plan which will make the stolen millions worthless.

movies.title: JIFF: A Man Of His Time
movies.synopsis: September 1940. Henri Marre arrives alone in Vichy as the authoritarian regime settles in. Broke, estranged from his family, and carrying copies of his self-published manifesto Notre Salut (Our Salvation), the 49-year-old is determined to secure what he believes is his rightful place in the new administration. In his writing, Henri sets out his patriotic convictions and his engineer’s methodology: efficiency above all. Claiming he wants to help save France after defeat, he does whatever is required to remain useful, serving the machinery of the new order with increasing skill. But he may be pursuing something more urgent: escape from his own ruin
movies.chineseSynopsis: 灵感源自导演伊曼努尔·马雷曾祖父的生平及其书信，属于真实人物经历改编。1940年9月，维希政权逐渐稳固之际，49岁的亨利·马尔独自来到维希，身无分文，与家人决裂。他带着自费出版的宣言《我们的救赎》，试图在新政府中谋得一席之地，并以爱国信念和工程师准则证明自己的价值，逐渐成为新秩序运转中不可或缺的一环。然而，他真正急于摆脱的，或许是自己失败的人生。

movies.title: Under the Sea 3D
movies.synopsis: Imagine a world of incredible color and beauty. Of crabs wearing jellyfish for hats. Of fish disguised as frogs, stones and shag carpets. Of a kaleidoscope of life dancing and weaving, floating and darting in an underwater wonderland. Now, go explore it! Howard Hall and his filmmaking team, who brought you Deep Sea and Into the Deep, take you into tropical waters alive with adventure: the Great Barrier Reef and other South Pacific realms. Narrated by Jim Carrey and featuring astonishing camerawork, this amazing film brings you face to fin with Nature's marvels, from the terrible grandeur (and terrible teeth) of a Great White to the comic antics of a lovestruck cuttlefish. Excitement and fun run deep Under the Sea!
movies.chineseSynopsis: 首部IMAX海下立体电影，为拍摄此片，水下摄影师携带重达近4吨的专用装备，下潜到了南澳大利亚和巴布亚新几内亚以及印度洋海域，历时110天、潜水350小时，首次成功采用IMAX 3D 摄影机在水下进行冒险拍摄。3D的视觉效果让观众与地球上最独特、最危险、最色彩斑斓的生物零距离接触，体验一次难得的深海旅行。

movies.title: Rose of Nevada
movies.synopsis: When a fishing boat, the Rose of Nevada, lost with all hands 30 years ago, mysteriously reappears in the old harbour of a forgotten Cornish village, for those who remember, it’s surely a sign. The boat must go out to sea again and maybe then the luck of the devastated village will turn. Young father Nick and enigmatic newcomer Liam join captain Murgey, and they head to sea. But when they return, satisfied with their haul, something is amiss – they’ve slipped back in time, and the villagers greet them as if they are the original crew.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 三十年前，“内华达之瑰”号消失于海上。如今，它回来了。两名为生计所迫的男子加入其船员队伍，再度起航，却很快发现自己被送回了过去，并被误认为原船员。

movies.title: Hackers
movies.countryOrigin: United States of America / United Kingdom
movies.synopsis: Along with his new friends, a teenager who was arrested by the US Secret Service and banned from using a computer for writing a computer virus discovers a plot by a nefarious hacker, but they must use their computer skills to find the evidence while being pursued by the Secret Service and the evil computer genius behind the virus.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 达德（约翰·李·米勒 Jonny Lee Miller 饰）是一名出色的天才黑客，曾经，股市因为11岁的他的小小恶作剧而差点崩盘，达德因此被剥夺了使用网络的权利，如今，已经成年的达德终于重新获得了这一权利，跃跃欲试的他摩拳擦掌，准备在网络上重新大展拳脚。凯特（安吉丽娜·朱莉 Angelina Jolie 饰）和乔伊（杰西·布拉德福特 Jesse Bradford 饰）都是如同达德一样的黑客，他们因为趣味相投而走到了一起成为了好友。普拉格（费舍·史蒂芬斯 Fisher Stevens 饰）曾经是一名技术高超的超级黑客，如今，被招安的他成为了一家大公司的系统安全专家。背地里，普拉格和黑恶势力勾结，谋取公司账户里的巨额财产，此外，他还发明了一种能令全球网络陷入瘫痪的可怕病毒。一次偶然中，达德一行人发现了普拉格的罪恶和阴谋，他们决定给利用自己的力量，阻止普拉格。 ©豆瓣

movies.title: Tangerine
movies.synopsis: It's Christmas Eve in Tinseltown and Sin-Dee is back on the block. Upon hearing that her pimp boyfriend hasn't been faithful during the 28 days she was locked up, the working girl and her best friend, Alexandra, embark on a mission to get to the bottom of the scandalous rumor. Their rip-roaring odyssey leads them through various subcultures of Los Angeles, including an Armenian family dealing with their own repercussions of infidelity.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 圣诞前夕的浮华城，辛迪回到了街头。当得知她的皮条客男友在她被拘留的28天内出轨，这位应召女郎与她的挚友亚历山德拉展开了一场探寻丑闻真相的行动。她们喧闹激烈的穿梭之旅，将她们带入了洛杉矶的各种亚文化圈，其中包括一个因出轨事件而陷入纠葛的亚美尼亚家庭。

movies.title: Dersu Uzala
movies.tagline: There is man and beast at nature's mercy. There is awe and love and reverence. And there is the man called...
movies.synopsis: A military explorer meets and befriends a Goldi man in Russia’s unmapped forests. A deep and abiding bond evolves between the two men, one civilized in the usual sense, the other at home in the glacial Siberian woods.
movies.chineseTagline: 自然面前，人与兽皆受其支配。这里有敬畏，有挚爱，亦有虔诚。而世间存在着这样一位被称作……的人。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 在风雪交加的寒冷高地大兴安岭，一群俄国探险科考队员在队长亚森尼耶夫（虞瑞•索罗民Yuri Solomin 饰）的带领下进驻这里，寻找附近的资源矿藏。这些远离家乡的队员，每到夜晚的时候，都会唱起思乡的歌曲表达各自的离愁别绪。正在此时，他们聆听到一阵悠扬的旋律，后来才发现有个当地的蒙古老猎手德尔苏•乌扎（马克西姆•门祖克 Maksim Munzuk 饰）拉常年驻扎此地。为了能够在陌生的地方不被野兽吞噬不走弯路，队长决定雇佣德尔苏•乌扎拉为向导，指引军队前行，后者欣然应允，并且帮助他们躲过了老虎的血盆大口，穿越了活埋死人的沙丘，在与自然的对抗与相处中，德尔苏•乌扎拉和科考队员慢慢地建立了跨文化的深厚情谊，他们对自然的认识也逐渐加深…… 　　本片获第48届奥斯卡最佳外语片。

movies.title: Au revoir les enfants
movies.synopsis: Au revoir les enfants tells a heartbreaking story of friendship and devastating loss concerning two boys living in Nazi-occupied France. At a provincial Catholic boarding school, the precocious youths enjoy true camaraderie—until a secret is revealed. Based on events from writer-director Malle’s own childhood, the film is a subtle, precisely observed tale of courage, cowardice, and tragic awakening.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 讲述了纳粹占领下的法国，两名男孩之间一段关乎友谊与毁灭性失去的痛心故事。在一所偏远的天主教寄宿学校里，两位聪慧早熟的少年曾享有真挚情谊——直到一个秘密被揭开。这部基于编剧兼导演路易·马勒亲身童年经历的电影，以含蓄细腻而又洞察入微的叙事，探讨了勇气、懦弱与悲剧性的觉醒。[标准收藏]

movies.title: Life Is Sweet
movies.synopsis: Just north of London live Wendy, Andy, and their twenty-something twins, Natalie and Nicola. Wendy clerks in a shop, Andy is a cook who forever puts off home remodeling projects, Natalie is a plumber and Nicola is jobless. This film is about how they interact and play out family, conflict and love.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 这部迈克·李执导的活力四射之作，是他首部引发国际轰动的电影。影片以忧郁与幽默交织的笔触，细腻勾勒伦敦北部郊区一个工人阶级家庭的日常图景——一对难以自抑的父母与他们如昼与夜般截然不同的双胞胎女儿：沉静好学的乖乖女和阴郁暴躁的失意者。迈克·李与其一贯出色的演员团队以非凡的敏感度与技巧，共同创造出这个生动鲜活的平凡生活故事，其中即便如父亲渴望经营餐车这般微小的梦想，亦承载着千钧之重。[标准收藏]

movies.title: Wake in Fright
movies.tagline: Have a drink, mate? Have a fight, mate? Have some dust and sweat, mate? There's nothing else out here.
movies.synopsis: A young schoolteacher descends into personal moral degradation after finding himself stranded in a brutal, menacing town in outback Australia.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 影片讲述一名英国教师被困在澳大利亚内陆小镇时，在一群醉酒疯癫的流浪汉手中逐渐陷入精神崩溃的故事。[Drafthouse Films]

movies.title: The Watermelon Woman
movies.tagline: Sometimes you have to create your own history.
movies.synopsis: A young black lesbian filmmaker probes into the life of The Watermelon Woman, a 1930s black actress who played 'mammy' archetypes.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 热爱电影的雪莉爱做白日梦。这阵子，她满脑子都是「西瓜女」─早期美国电影里一名不见经传的黑人女演员。她在一家租售录影带的小店工作，进进出出的都是同道中人─女同志。某天，一名风情万种的白人女子闯进了她的生命，从此，平淡的生活变成了惊险刺激的游乐场过山车。Cheryl Dunye曾拍过多部录像作品，探讨黑人女同志生活里种族、性别与阶级醒觉的关系。这回她首度拍剧情片，使尽浑身解数，自编自导自演，将大都市女同志社群的生态拍得尖锐生动，抵死幽默处令人捧腹。

movies.title: True Stories
movies.synopsis: A small but growing Texas town, filled with strange and musical characters, celebrates its sesquicentennial and converge on a local parade and talent show.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 本片以主人公大卫·布莱恩架车游历美国得克萨斯州过程中所见所闻为主线，透过一个个具有鲜明个性的小人物及发生在他们身上的故事，展示了当地人对于生活和爱情的独特理解。该片值得称道的是将歌舞与写实完美结合，大量旋律优美的乡村民谣,歌曲成为片中最耀眼的亮点，也是导演大卫·布莱恩对电影艺术的创新之举，是一次成功的探索。

movies.title: Secrets & Lies
movies.tagline: Roxanne drives her mother crazy. Maurice never speaks to his niece. Cynthia has a shock for her family. Monica can't talk to her husband. Hortense has never met her mother.
movies.synopsis: After her adoptive mother dies, Hortense, a successful black optometrist, seeks out her birth mother. She's shocked when her research leads her to Cynthia, a working class white woman.
movies.chineseTagline: 罗克珊让她母亲抓狂。莫里斯从不和他的侄女说话。辛西娅给她的家人带来了一个震惊的消息。莫妮卡无法与她的丈夫交谈。霍滕斯从未见过她的母亲。
movies.chineseSynopsis: 作为洞察质朴人性的卓越观察者，编剧兼导演迈克·李通过探索那些塑造我们人际关系的或大或小的欺瞒，在这部作品中达到了表现力与叙事复杂度的新高度。黑人验光师霍滕丝自幼被收养，当她开始寻找生母时，并未料到这将引领她遇见辛西娅——一位孤独的白人工厂女工。她对失散多年女儿迟疑的接纳，在她本就脆弱的家庭中激起了层层波澜。影片通过与实力派群星的精心排练和即兴创作孕育而生，这部荣获金棕榈奖的杰作，以贯穿始终的张力与情感释放，深刻揭示了潜伏于日常生活中的情感断层。[标准收藏]

movies.title: Ghost World
movies.synopsis: Two quirky and cynical teenage girls try to figure out what to do with their lives following high school graduation. After they play a prank on an eccentric, middle-aged record collector, one of them befriends him, which causes a rift in the girls’ friendship.
movies.chineseSynopsis: 特里·茨威戈夫的首部剧情长片改编自丹尼尔·克洛斯的邪典经典漫画，以独特笔触描绘青少年疏离感，既浸透着冷峻幽默又充满动人温情。故事发生于高中毕业后的迷惘岁月，骄傲的叛逆少女伊妮德在消费主义美国的文化荒原中直面不确定的未来。当她的愤世嫉俗连挚友爱贝卡也难以承受时，伊妮德发现自己竟与一位年长许多的悲催唱片收藏家产生了意想不到的精神共鸣。凭借其怪诞角色群像、入选奥斯卡提名、金句频出的剧本，以及杂糅复古冷门曲目的不拘一格原声，本片堪称二十一世纪最受狂热喜爱的喜剧之一。[标准收藏]

comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 改编自弗兰克·赫伯特的科幻小说《沙丘2：沙丘救世主》。保罗·厄崔迪夺取帝国统治权近二十年后，成为冷酷的皇帝。面对旧盟友回归、新威胁浮现与暗中背叛，保罗深陷一场阴谋，并必须直面权力的代价与所爱之人的命运。

comingSoonMovies.title: Angel and the Badman
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 翻拍自1947年同名西部电影。亡命枪手奎特·埃文斯身负枪伤，倒在一位牧场主的土地上，原以为自己必死无疑，却意外得到宽恕。牧场主的女儿佩妮给了他摆脱暴力、重新生活的机会。然而，随着警长步步逼近，亡命帮派也威胁要烧毁牧场，奎特必须决定自己究竟要成为怎样的人。

comingSoonMovies.title: The Uprising
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 在中世纪的英格兰，一位无畏的勇士召集平民发动了一场激烈的起义，反抗国王理查德二世的高压统治。随着国家陷入混乱，他的起义军与王室军队展开了一场绝望的自由之战。

comingSoonMovies.title: Violent Night 2
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 因杀戮过重，圣诞老人被剥夺神力并困于新泽西州一座废弃商场，与北极彻底失联。此时，犯罪头目正率领武装爪牙及叛变的邪恶精灵企图摧毁小镇的圣诞氛围。失去超能力的他只能依靠凡人肉体，将彩灯、姜饼模具等圣诞装饰化为致命武器，在迷宫般的商场内与匪帮展开血腥巷战。就在他陷入劣势之际，武力值爆表的“战斗型”圣诞老婆婆持剑杀入战场驰援。夫妻二人并肩作战，誓要将整座商场变成给坏蛋们的最终礼物盒。

comingSoonMovies.title: Lilo & Scratch
comingSoonMovies.synopsis: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.
comingSoonMovies.chineseSynopsis: 故事设定在2002年原作之后：史迪奇终于在新家庭中过上了幸福安稳的日子，直到莉萝带回家一位新成员——一只粉色的外星小猫喵喵琦。这位新成员捣乱成性、光芒四射，无孔不入地渗透进史迪奇的生活，把他的整个世界搅了个天翻地覆。
